integration_boundary: The current Studio module v1 contract is static HTML/CSS. These descriptors are research data, not executable modules or a supported Studio API.
lifecycle_requirements: A stable target ID binds the effect; the editor owns the outer placement transform.
Animation uses a separate inner wrapper; removing a block cancels observers, listeners, animation frames and pending tasks.
Use scoped styles and unique filter IDs. Do not read global document nodes as component targets.
A missing API or reduced-motion setting keeps content and navigation usable.
Pause continuous renderers offscreen and when the document is hidden.
Exports must carry their minimal runtime, licensed local assets, notices and fallback.

effects.name: Fade and rise
effects.acceptance: Reveal on entry; once=true must not replay after leaving and re-entering.
effects.export_recipe: Inline scoped transform/opacity CSS and an observer; content starts readable if JS fails.
effects.reduced_motion: Show final position and full opacity.

effects.name: Mask reveal
effects.acceptance: A circle from the selected origin or a directional rectangle reveals all corners after an image change.
effects.export_recipe: Inline clip-path keyframes and a trigger; remove clipping in the unsupported fallback.
effects.reduced_motion: Show the complete target immediately.

reuse_candidates.limitation: Line-mask reveal; no configurable circle or image mask.

effects.name: Hand-drawn annotation
effects.acceptance: Underline or circle remains aligned after wrapping; repeated entry creates no duplicate SVG nodes.
effects.export_recipe: Bundle the chosen licensed annotation runtime; measure after fonts load and on resize.
effects.reduced_motion: Render the completed annotation.

effects.name: Character and word stagger
effects.acceptance: Chinese and English reveal in reading order; assistive technology receives the complete sentence; split only once.
effects.export_recipe: Inline original splitting logic and indexed CSS; preserve a whole accessible text alternative.
effects.reduced_motion: Show the complete sentence immediately.

reuse_candidates.limitation: Line-level reveal only; grapheme splitting and full new acceptance remain pending.
Button-specific stagger; not a generic text effect.

effects.name: Typewriter and erase
effects.acceptance: Preserve Chinese and emoji graphemes, reserve layout space and allow looping to stop.
effects.export_recipe: Write original plain JavaScript; do not bundle current Typed.js code in the permissive component pack.
effects.reduced_motion: Show the complete text without a blinking cursor.

effects.name: Number counter
effects.acceptance: Handle negative numbers, decimals and units; finish at the exact formatted destination value.
effects.export_recipe: Bundle the chosen counter or original formatter; initial HTML contains the readable final value.
effects.reduced_motion: Set the final formatted number immediately.

effects.name: Card tilt and glare
effects.target: Card, cover or button inner wrapper
effects.acceptance: Reset on pointer leave, preserve touch clicks and recompute bounds after editor movement.
effects.export_recipe: Keep editor placement on an outer wrapper and tilt transforms on an inner effect layer.
effects.reduced_motion: Keep the card static.

reuse_candidates.limitation: Book rotation study; general card/glare adapter and editor transform separation are pending.
Button tilt preset; not a general card component.

effects.name: Cursor trail
effects.target: Creative cover or bounded canvas section
effects.acceptance: Stay inside the selected block; removing the block removes its listeners and canvases.
effects.export_recipe: Use a block-scoped pointer-events:none canvas and an explicit destroy lifecycle.
effects.reduced_motion: Keep the system cursor with no trail.

effects.name: Success confetti
effects.target: Completion area or button feedback layer
effects.acceptance: A real success event fires once; an ordinary click must not manufacture business success; rendering stops after completion.
effects.export_recipe: Bundle a one-shot renderer; keep independent readable success text.
effects.reduced_motion: Skip particles and retain the status text.

reuse_candidates.limitation: Sparks preset is visual feedback, not a verified business-success confetti contract.

effects.name: Reading progress
effects.target: Article progress bar or sidebar indicator
effects.acceptance: Main article top is 0% and bottom is 100%; scrolling an independent sidebar must not change article progress.
effects.export_recipe: Use a scoped scroll timeline with a JS fallback when needed; bind the actual scroll container.
effects.reduced_motion: Synchronize progress without additional smoothing.

effects.name: Image parallax
effects.target: Image or cover inside a clipping wrapper
effects.acceptance: Scrolling forward and backward is reversible; narrow layouts expose no empty edges; pause offscreen.
effects.export_recipe: Export self-owned images, a crop wrapper and a native JavaScript entry point.
effects.reduced_motion: Render a static cover image.

reuse_candidates.limitation: Layered narrative motion; not image parallax with crop guarantees.

effects.name: Shared-element transition
effects.acceptance: Open the matching image and restore focus on return; navigation still works without the API.
effects.export_recipe: Use unique view-transition names and a same-document state update; provide an immediate update fallback.
effects.reduced_motion: Update state and restore focus immediately.

reuse_candidates.limitation: Existing shared-image study; native View Transition API adapter remains pending.

effects.name: Flowing mesh gradient
effects.acceptance: Pause offscreen; disabling WebGL leaves readable content and working controls.
effects.export_recipe: Bundle only the chosen native shader entry; retain Apache LICENSE and NOTICE; include a CSS gradient base.
effects.reduced_motion: Use a static gradient with no rendering loop.

effects.name: Paper and film grain
effects.acceptance: Two instances have independent filter IDs; texture does not intercept clicks.
effects.export_recipe: Inline an original SVG feTurbulence filter with a unique ID per instance.
effects.reduced_motion: Keep the texture static; never animate the seed.

reuse_candidates.limitation: Film shader study; the standalone SVG texture is a new implementation.

effects.name: Ink edge
effects.target: Self-owned SVG shape or chapter illustration
effects.acceptance: Distort shape edges only; body text remains clear and expanded filter bounds prevent clipping.
effects.export_recipe: Compose original turbulence and displacement filters; keep text outside the filtered subtree.
effects.reduced_motion: Use a static ink shape or the original undistorted shape.

reuse_candidates.limitation: Canvas ink illustration; not an SVG displacement filter.

effects.name: SVG stroke drawing
effects.target: Logo, map line or icon path
effects.acceptance: Paths of different lengths complete correctly and remain fully visible.
effects.export_recipe: Use original getTotalLength/dash animation or a licensed minimal engine with self-owned SVG paths.
effects.reduced_motion: Display complete paths.

effects.name: SVG contour morph
effects.target: Two compatible icon or illustration shapes
effects.acceptance: Rapid repeated toggles finish at the path matching the current application state.
effects.export_recipe: Export compatible self-owned paths and a chosen interpolator; cancel superseded transitions.
effects.reduced_motion: Replace the path immediately.

effects.name: Variable font axes
effects.target: Heading or index with supported font axes
effects.acceptance: The title fits its container; without the variable font the complete text remains readable.
effects.export_recipe: Embed only a font licensed for redistribution; include a system-font fallback.
effects.reduced_motion: Use fixed width and weight.

reuse_candidates.limitation: Axis controls and geometric width fallback; no licensed variable font is bundled.

effects.name: Linked particle background
effects.acceptance: Moving or removing a block leaves no extra canvases; reduce density on mobile.
effects.export_recipe: Bundle only the required engine and Links preset; impose a particle budget and static fallback.
effects.reduced_motion: Use static points or a solid background.

reuse_candidates.limitation: WebGL sphere/torus morph; not the Links canvas recipe.

effects.name: Frosted glass panel
effects.acceptance: Text remains readable over light and dark backgrounds; unsupported blur has an opaque fallback.
effects.export_recipe: Inline scoped backdrop-filter CSS with a sufficiently opaque contrast base.
effects.reduced_motion: Keep blur fixed without animation.
